info.title: FrontierSight Workbench API
info.description: Supported scene editing, canonical playback preparation, analysis/simulation handoff, segmentation and billing availability. This contract does not enumerate every legacy account endpoint. Single-image 3D visualization does not imply measured depth or physical calibration.

post.summary: Scale all paths into a new floor, fit sampled smooth-curve envelopes and keep physical radii and speeds unchanged.
post.description: Pure computation: no saved record, account or billing state is modified. Save the returned scene separately through the authenticated scene-storage API. Anonymous per-client POST rate limits apply.

200.description: Edited scene

post.summary: Move one object’s first waypoint toward x/y, translating its complete path. Clamps movement to keep the path and footprint inside the floor.
post.description: Pure computation: no saved record, account or billing state is modified. Save the returned scene separately through the authenticated scene-storage API. Anonymous per-client POST rate limits apply.

200.description: Edited scene

get.summary: Describe the deterministic MCP tool catalog

200.description: Tool names, descriptions and transport information

post.summary: MCP JSON-RPC transport including resize_scene and reposition_scene

200.description: JSON-RPC response; tool failures have result.isError=true

post.summary: Segment a user-supplied JPEG or PNG with SAM; return real decoded masks when available
post.description: Model-backed operation; the deployment must have a Meta API key. The public demo uses its host key and applies a separate 30-request/minute model limit per client, in addition to the general POST limit. No match is a successful result with empty frames. A decode budget/failure is explicit (decoded=false); never treat a bounding box as a decoded silhouette. Image-derived extrusion depth remains an assumption, not calibrated geometry.

concept.description: One short noun phrase; send separate requests for different concepts.

200.description: Completed segmentation, including valid zero matches

post.summary: Prepare a complete scene for Studio and Counterfactual playback
post.description: Preserves declared floor, object definitions, custom appearance, path modes and physical radii. Samples bounded 10 Hz tracks over at most 20 seconds, carrying a scene digest. Requires every object to be placed. No saved state or model call.

200.description: Canonical USER_UPLOADED scenario including stage_metres, objects, scene_digest and tracks

post.summary: Simulate a scene while preserving floor, definitions and physical footprints
post.description: Pass a complete scene plus agent_id and optional target_id. Existing tracks-only requests remain supported. A complete scene is resampled on the server; supplied client tracks are not trusted as a substitute. Monte-Carlo limits follow authenticated plan entitlements; MCP is capped at 200. Responses include the input floor, definitions and digest alongside simulation results.

200.description: Path-following comparison, declared scene context and provenance

400.description: Invalid scene, agent, target or parameters

402.description: Simulation budget exceeds the current plan

post.summary: Analyze a complete edited scene without losing its floor or definitions
post.description: New clients pass scene. Legacy tracks requests remain supported. Returns run plus the canonical scenario with stage_metres, objects, digest and sampled tracks. Analysis may invoke a configured reasoning provider and consume model credits; this model-backed operation is not an MCP tool.

200.description: Analysis run and canonical scenario

get.summary: Public offer and checkout availability without secret values

200.description: USD prices, supported periods and live/test/unavailable checkout mode. Availability does not claim a customer transaction was completed.

post.summary: Generate a bounded candidate batch and select one scene
post.description: 1–8 parallel calls to the selected model. No automatic provider or quality-repair retries. Shared 28-second provider deadline; completed valid candidates are ranked by deterministic path-quality heuristics. Browser cancellation does not guarantee remote provider cancellation. A 503 indicates another batch still owns this process capacity. Existing offline templates are explicitly labelled. This model-generation endpoint is not exposed by the deterministic MCP server.

200.description: One validated scene and candidate metadata

202.description: Model credentials unavailable; no matching offline template

502.description: No valid candidate or provider failure

504.description: Deadline reached without a valid candidate
